period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'BALANCE SHEET' heading without the 'CONSOLIDATED' prefix used elsewhere in the same filing, per project convention of preferring Solo over Consolidated). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (as published in UCB's own standalone unaudited interim financial statements filed on ucb.com.bd's investor-relations Financial Statements archive -- a different, richer source than the FY2013-2016 annual-report-embedded audit-committee table used elsewhere in this dataset) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as FY2013-2016. Most of this era's UCB interim-statement PDFs (2017 through 2023, plus 2025 Q1/Q2) are pure image scans with no embedded text layer, requiring tesseract 5.5.3 OCR (150dpi full-document pass to locate the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Notes pages, keyed off page headings, since page layout/count varies by year); the 2024 and 2025 Q3 filings do have an embedded text layer but it uses a corrupted font character-to-glyph mapping that pdftotext cannot read for numeric cells, so those were instead re-rendered at 300dpi and OCR'd the same way. All PDFs were downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd and deleted immediately after extraction per project policy. Figures extracted via targeted 300dpi re-render + OCR of this filing's own Balance Sheet/P&L/Notes pages (the native-embedded PDF text layer uses a font with broken character mapping and is unusable for the numeric cells, though headings extract fine); every figure below reconciles internally (Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity to the taka) and net_profit_after_tax_cumulative's own comparative column (562,710,187) matches the independently-sourced 2023_Q1 figure exactly.
